question.prompt: Henry’s Hamburger Heaven offers its hamburgers with the following condiments: ketchup, mustard, mayonnaise, tomato, lettuce, pickles, cheese, and onions. A customer can choose one, two, or three meat patties, and any collection of condiments. How many different kinds of hamburgers can be ordered?

solutions.explanation:
For each of the \(8\) condiments, the customer makes one of two choices: include it or leave it out. These choices can be made freely, giving
\[
2^8=256
\]
collections of condiments. This includes choosing no condiments and choosing all eight.

Each collection can accompany \(1\), \(2\), or \(3\) meat patties, so the total is
\[
3\cdot256=\boxed{768}.
\]
Every hamburger has exactly one patty count and one set of include-or-omit choices, so every kind is counted once. The answer is choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
solutions.title: Make one choice for each ingredient
